verdict.summary: Use Xero OAuth to connect each customer organisation. You can start testing on Starter. Before a sixth connection, you need payment details and a paid plan with certification requirements. Xero does not state a fixed review time. Build connection management and disconnect flows early. Apply in Manage Plan.
verdict.activeEffort: 2–4 days (estimate), mostly OAuth, connection management, error handling, and—if the app writes data—account-code mapping
verdict.waitTime: Unknown: no fixed certification review time was found in the researched official materials.
verdict.mainGate: Before adding a sixth connection, add payment details and move to a paid plan. Core and Plus require App Certification. Certification prerequisites include Sign Up with Xero and ten active customer connections.

recommendation.text: Use a Web OAuth app for a server backend. Use PKCE, a proof code flow, if an agent tool cannot keep a client secret safe. Do not use Custom Connections because each one connects to only one organisation.

sources.quote: The standard flow is the most well known OAuth 2.0 flow and typically used by web server applications.
Use PKCE. It’s the flow we recommend because it doesn’t need a client secret, so there’s no secret to leak into a prompt, a configuration file or an AI development tool.
Custom Connections can only ever connect to a single organisation.

scopeTiers.text: Read a customer's invoices without changing them. This is the lowest-cost financial data tier.

sources.quote: accounting.invoices.read | New | View invoices | _As above but GET only_

scopeTiers.text: Create or update invoices and payments. Keep account-code mapping for all accounting writes. Certification is needed when moving beyond five connections.

sources.quote: accounting.invoices | New | View and manage invoices
accounting.payments | New | View and manage payments
If your integration needs to create data in Xero, you will need mapping functionality so that users can select one or more account codes

scopeTiers.scopes: openid; profile; email; offline_access; accounting.invoices; accounting.payments

scopeTiers.text: Read journals. This needs the Advanced plan and certification, so it has the highest review and cost burden.

sources.quote: accounting.journals.read is no longer granted by default. To access journals, you'll need the Advanced tier and certification.

essentials.text: Request offline_access for background access. Access tokens last up to 30 minutes. Refresh tokens last up to 60 days and rotate on every use. Save both new tokens together. The prior refresh token works for a 30-minute recovery period.

sources.quote: To get a refresh token, you must request the offline_access scope. A refresh token allows you to refresh your access token and maintain an offline connection.
They are only valid for up to 30 minutes
These are valid for up to 60 days.
Every time you use a `refresh_token`, you will get a new one along with the new `access_token`. You will need to use this `refresh_token` in the future.
you can retry using your existing refresh token for a grace period of 30 minutes.

essentials.text: Register exact HTTPS callback addresses. localhost is allowed for testing. Wildcards and custom URI schemes are not allowed. You may register up to 50 addresses.

sources.quote: This must be an https address, however for testing you can use http://localhost/
The OAuth 2.0 spec (section 3.1.2 of RFC 6749) requires that a redirection URI must be an absolute URI. The use of wildcards in redirect URI is not supported.
You can use up to 50 redirect URIs for your app.
All redirect URIs must be https with the exception of localhost. Custom URL Schemes are not supported.

essentials.text: Start with a free Xero account and a demo company. Demo data resets after 28 days and needs reconnection. Use a trial organisation to invite test users. Trials require billing information after 30 days.

sources.quote: The demo company is the best way to learn how Xero works and to test an integration or add-on.
data will be automatically reset 28 days after creation
other users can be invited to your organisation
is limited to 30 days before billing information is required

essentials.text: Limit each customer's organisation to five concurrent calls and 60 calls each minute. Starter allows 1,000 daily calls. Higher plans allow 5,000. Handle HTTP 429 and obey Retry-After.

sources.quote: Concurrent Limit: 5 calls in progress at one time
Minute Limit: 60 calls per minute
Daily Limit: 1,000 calls per day for starter, 5,000 calls per day for higher tiers
If you have exceed the minute or daily limit you will also receive a Retry-After http header that tells you how many seconds to wait

essentials.text: Starter supports five connections at no charge. Core supports 50 for $35 AUD monthly. Plus supports 1,000 for $245 AUD monthly. Advanced supports 10,000 for $1,445 AUD monthly. Prices exclude tax.

sources.quote:

essentials.text: Stay on Starter for up to five connections. Before adding a sixth, add payment details and move to a paid plan. Core and Plus need certification. Advanced also needs an initial and annual security assessment.

sources.quote: New apps default to the starter tier with 5 connections.
In order to add a 6th connection, you will need to first add your payment details.

Prerequisites
App Certification
App Certification
App Certification

Security Assessment (initial and annual)
Security Assessment (initial and annual)

essentials.text: Apply in Developer Centre through your app's Manage Plan page. Prepare Sign Up with Xero and ten active customer connections. Be ready to provide a test account. Xero does not publish a fixed review time.

sources.quote: To do this, log into the Xero Developer Centre, Select your app, then click ‘Manage Plan’.
Checking your app meets prerequisites e.g. you’ve built Sign Up with Xero and have ten active customer connections.
You may need to provision a test account for us.

essentials.text: Keep tokens and secrets off client devices. Encrypt refresh tokens at rest with AES-128 or stronger. Use TLS 1.2 with AES-256 or stronger. Set Secure and HTTPOnly session cookies.

sources.quote: Never show or store sensitive data like the access token, client id and client secret in the client side of the application
Encrypt the refresh token with a symmetric algorithm (3DES or AES). AES-128 or greater is preferred.
TLS version 1.2 using AES 256 or higher with SHA-256 is mandatory.
All app session cookies have the following attributes set: Secure and HTTPOnly

requests.text: Open this browser URL after deriving CODE_CHALLENGE from CODE_VERIFIER with S256.

sources.quote: https://login.xero.com/identity/connect/authorize?response_type=code&client_id=YOURCLIENTID&redirect_uri=YOURREDIRECTURI&scope=openid profile email accounting.invoices&state=123&code_challenge=XXXXXXXXX&code_challenge_method=S256
code_challenge = BASE64URL-ENCODE(SHA256(ASCII(code_verifier)))

requests.label: Send the user to sign in

requests.text: Exchange the one-time code within 5 minutes using the original code verifier.

sources.quote:
POST https://identity.xero.com/connect/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=authorization_code
&client_id=zzzzzzzz
&code=xxxxxx
&redirect_uri=https://myapp.com/redirect
&code_verifier=yyyyyyy
code a temporary code that may only be exchanged once and expires 5 minutes after issuance.

requests.label: Exchange the code for tokens

requests.text: Save the replacement access token and refresh token returned by this request.

sources.quote:
POST https://identity.xero.com/connect/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=refresh_token
&client_id=zzzzzzz
&refresh_token=xxxxxx
The response will contain a new access token and refresh token. You must save both tokens in order to maintain api access.

requests.label: Refresh the access token

requests.text: List the Xero tenants the user authorized and retain the returned tenantId for tenant API calls.

sources.quote:
GET https://api.xero.com/connections
Authorization: "Bearer " + access_token
Content-Type: application/json
Find out which tenants the user has authorized by calling the connections endpoint.

requests.label: Check the connection

requests.text: This revokes the refresh token and removes all of the user's connections to the app.

sources.quote:
POST https://identity.xero.com/connect/revocation
authorization: "Basic " + base64encode(client_id + ":")
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

token=xxxxxx
You can revoke a user’s refresh token and remove all their connections to your app by making a request to the revocation endpoint.

requests.label: Revoke access

steps.title: Create an OAuth app

detail.text: Sign up for a free Xero account. In Developer Centre, add an OAuth 2.0 app. Choose Web for a server backend.

sources.quote: Signup for a free Xero account
Add your OAuth 2.0 application (you’ll be prompted to login to Xero first)

steps.output: A Web OAuth app in Xero Developer Centre.

steps.title: Choose minimum scopes

detail.text: Start with read-only scopes. Add a write scope only for a shipped feature. This reduces consent and certification risk.

sources.quote: Only request the minimal scopes that you require to fulfil the intended use cases of your integration.

steps.output:
Scopes: openid profile email offline_access accounting.invoices.read
Use read-only invoices first. Add accounting.invoices only for invoice writes. Add accounting.payments only for payment writes. Do not request journals unless the Advanced plan is approved.

steps.title: Add callback addresses

detail.text: In My Apps, add your exact callback addresses. Use HTTPS in production. Use http://localhost/ only for local testing.

sources.quote: This must be an https address, however for testing you can use http://localhost/
The OAuth 2.0 spec (section 3.1.2 of RFC 6749) requires that a redirection URI must be an absolute URI. The use of wildcards in redirect URI is not supported.

steps.output: Exact production HTTPS callback and localhost test callback.

steps.title: Implement safe OAuth callback

detail.text: Use a random state for every authorization attempt. Reject a mismatched callback. Exchange the code quickly, then save only authorised organisation connections.

sources.quote: If the states don’t match, the request may have been created by a third party and you should abort the process.
code a temporary code that may only be exchanged once and expires 5 minutes after issuance.
you can make API calls by providing both a valid access token and authorized tenant id with each request.

detail.text: Create a demo company and connect the app. Test reading and writing separately. Reconnect after its 28-day reset.

sources.quote: comes pre-populated with dummy data
When the demo company resets (after 28 days) you will need to reconnect your app to the demo company.

steps.title: Confirm organisation before writes

detail.text: Track the selected organisation for each request and make it clear to the user before any write. Require an agent confirmation step before executing a data-changing action.

sources.quote: Each call runs against one organisation.
Data-changing tools require an agent confirmation step before execution.

steps.output: A tested write confirmation screen showing the selected organisation.

steps.title: Build certification evidence

detail.text: Use this checklist to compare the product against certification requirements. Attach screenshots and reviewer test steps after you verify them. Include a settings page, user-visible API errors, reconnect handling, and a disconnect flow that deletes the tenant connection through the Connections endpoint. Include account-code mapping if the app creates accounting data.

sources.quote: Ensure you implement a setup page that allows users to connect to Xero and manage their settings for the integration.
Use the method of DELETE from the Connections endpoint to remove a connection to a tenant.
It is essential to find a way to let users know an error has taken place, within your integration.

steps.output:
Reviewer checklist:
- Settings page connects and manages Xero.
- Disconnect removes the Xero connection.
- Reconnect appears after disconnection.
- API errors appear to the user.
- Writes require account-code mapping.
- Tokens remain server-side and encrypted.
- Xero data is never used for model training.

steps.title: Apply for certification

detail.text: Open your app's Manage Plan page after meeting the stated prerequisites, including Sign Up with Xero and ten active customer connections. Provide a test account if Xero asks.

sources.quote: To do this, log into the Xero Developer Centre, Select your app, then click ‘Manage Plan’.
You may need to provision a test account for us.

steps.output: A completed Manage Plan application and reviewer test account.

detail.text: Wait for Xero's certification decision. No fixed certification turnaround was found in the researched sources.

steps.title: Add billing before growth

detail.text: Before the sixth connection, add payment details and meet the requirements for the paid plan. Core and Plus require App Certification. Advanced requires an initial and annual security assessment; journal access also requires Advanced and certification. Choose Advanced only if journals are essential.

sources.quote: In order to add a 6th connection, you will need to first add your payment details.
accounting.journals.read is no longer granted by default. To access journals, you'll need the Advanced tier and certification.

steps.output: Payment details and an approved paid plan.

steps.title: Enforce data-use boundaries

detail.text: Block Xero data from all training and model-improvement pipelines. Obtain user consent before sending that data to another AI provider. Keep use limited to the approved app feature.

sources.quote: API Data cannot be used to train, fine tune, adapt, or enhance any AI Models.
API Data shall not be passed to another third party without consent from the associated user.

steps.output: A production policy that blocks Xero data from model training and asks consent before third-party AI processing.

gotchas.text: A user's Xero role can block an API call even when OAuth succeeded. Show a useful permission error and ask the user to reconnect with an authorised Xero user.

sources.quote: We are aligning authorisation on several endpoints with the roles and permissions described on Xero Central.

gotchas.text: New Web and PKCE apps use granular scopes. Do not build a new app around broad accounting scopes because they end in September 2027.

sources.quote: Web and PKCE apps – Since March 2026, all new and existing Web and PKCE apps have been assigned granular scopes.
Broad scopes will remain available until September 2027.

gotchas.text: A refresh failure after the 30-minute recovery period requires the user to authorise again.

sources.quote: After 30 minutes your previous refresh token will expire and the user will need to re-authorise your application

gotchas.text: If you use webhooks, verify x-xero-signature and make processing safe to repeat.

sources.quote: If the payload is hashed using HMACSHA256 with your webhook signing key and base64 encoded, it should match the signature in the header.
Consumer apps must ensure they implement idempotency logic and support message replayability to handle potential failure scenarios

whenBlocked.text: If certification is blocked or unclear when moving beyond five connections, submit an app-specific request through Developer Platform Support. Include the registered app name, affected organisation, summary, and details.

sources.quote: Name of the API application as registered in theMy appsarea
If there is a particular organisation that is affected by the issue, please provide the name of it so we can investigate further

whenBlocked.text: If access is for practice APIs, request prior approval at api@xero.com before building that feature.

sources.quote: Practice API’s including Xero Practice Manager - For prior approval please mail api@xero.com

whenBlocked.text: If the feature provides financial services, complete Xero's prior-approval form before seeking customer connections.

sources.quote: Financial services for example: banking, payments, lending and insurance amongst others that fall under Section 11 - For prior approval please complete this form.

uncertain: The exact certification application path for an app that needs ten active connections but starts with five connections is not explained in the researched sources.
